{{infobox weapon | image = Berserkir Axes.png | description = Let your rage take over and face the slaughter. | id = AxeBerzerkr | type = axe dw | source = [[Black Forge]] | crafting level = 3 | repair level = 3 | slash = 140 | chop = 80 |materials 1= * [[Charred Bone]] x15 * [[Flametal]] x24 * [[Asksvin Hide]] x3 |materials 2= * [[Flametal]] x15 * [[Asksvin Hide]] x1 |materials 3= * [[Flametal]] x30 * [[Asksvin Hide]] x2 |materials 4= * [[Flametal]] x60 * [[Asksvin Hide]] x4 | slash per level = 5 | chop per level = 3 | stamina = 16 | weight = 2.0 | durability = 300 | knockback = 20 | backstab = 3x | block armor = 57 | block force = 20 | block force per level = 5 | wielding = Dual wielded | parry bonus = 2 | movement speed = -5% }} The '''Berserkir axes''' is an [[Ashlands]]-tier dual wielded [[Axes|axe]]. Its primary attack is a 4-step combo: two single hits, one with each axe, followed by two double hits using both axes simultaneously, resulting in a total of 6 hits. The final double hit deals 2x damage with each individual hit. Its secondary attack costs 28 stamina and is a leap forward, followed by a slash with both axes for a single hit, dealing 2x the damage. The Berserkir axes deal [[Chop]] damage, which allows them to cut down trees, like all axes. They deal more Chop damage than the previous axe, the [[Jotun Bane]]. == Upgrading == Like most Ashlands-tier weapons, the Berserkir axes can be upgraded to one of the following three variants using gemstones: * {{Item link|Bleeding Berserkir Axes}} ([[Bloodstone]]) * {{Item link|Thundering Berserkir Axes}} ([[Iolite]]) * {{Item link|Primal Berserkir Axes}} ([[Jade]]) An upgraded Berserkir axes will '''NOT''' keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones. {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 |- !Slash |140 |145 |150 |155 |- !Durability |300 |350 |400 |450 |- !Crafting |15 [[Charred Bone]]
